needs_description: The agent is not showing demonstrations of reliably navigating along the left_edge corridor when hazards (fires) are present. It needs to see edge-case scenarios where the GOAL is along the left edge and fires are placed in central areas but not blocking the left_edge, forcing a left-hugging path. These demonstrations should include start positions near the top-left and varied fire placements that require forecasting hazards and committing to the left_edge corridor. Seeing these would help the agent learn hazard preemption and strict corridor adherence, reducing fire hits and improving success when the left_edge path is the safe route.

adjusted_prescription: The demonstrations did not include any examples of successfully navigating along the left edge corridor, which is crucial when the goal is located in the left column and fires are positioned in non-blocking spots. The available demonstrations mainly show paths along the right column, top row, or bottom row, with successful hazard avoidance on those routes. To improve the policy’s reliability, it is important to provide clear examples of moves specifically down the left edge, carefully avoiding fires placed near but not blocking that path. This focused guidance ensures that the agent learns to take the safest and most direct route when the goal requires traveling along the left edge. Therefore, additional demonstrations tailored to the left-edge corridor with hazard avoidance are necessary to teach this behavior effectively.
